title: Claw Care 101: The Ultimate Guide to Healthy Kits
description: Discover essential tips for maintaining strong, healthy claws and kits in the northern hemisphere this June.
main_content: As we enter June, the northern hemisphere's warm weather calls for special attention to claw and kit health. Start by ensuring your kits have a balanced diet rich in biotin and protein to promote claw strength. Regularly inspect claws for signs of cracking or overgrowth, and trim as needed using sharp, clean tools. For outdoor kits, provide scratching posts or rough surfaces to naturally file claws. Hydration is key—keep fresh water available to prevent dry, brittle claws. Finally, engage in daily play to encourage natural claw retraction and extension, keeping muscles and joints flexible.
key_takeaways: Feed kits a biotin-rich diet for strong claws.
Trim claws regularly to prevent overgrowth.
Provide scratching surfaces for natural filing.
Ensure constant hydration for claw flexibility.
Daily play promotes claw and joint health.
